text:
Priya Shah: Quick heads-up — planning to roll v2.3.1 to hosted and dedicated at 2026-03-20 18:00 UTC. No DB migrations. Canary on dedicated-1 for 10m. Need smoke owners and explicit rollback criteria. Ping if you can own checks.

Mark Liu: I can run the deploy and monitor canary. I'll start canary at 18:00. Notifying infra for capacity.

release-bot: Deployment scheduled: v2.3.1 -> canary:d1 -> 2026-03-20T18:00Z

Alice Tran: I'll do smoke + perf probes on prod routes (text-gen, embeddings). Smoke checklist:
- sanity: token outputs for 3 prompts
- p95 latency baseline compare
- error rate <0.5%
- cost macro check
I'll post results in thread.

Diego Morales: Rollback criteria proposal:
1) Error rate >= 0.5% sustained for 5m OR
2) p95 latency > 2x baseline AND > 800ms for 5m OR
3) Model quality regression: token-level QA fail rate > 2% on canary promptset
If any triggers -> immediate rollback.

SRE-oncall: We also require health endpoints green for 2 consecutive checks (30s apart) before promoting. If redis errors appear, rollback immediately.

Mark Liu: Rollback runbook (short):
```bash
# revert to previous container tag
kubectl set image deploy/redwood-api redwood-api=redwood/api:v2.3.0 -n prod
# reset traffic
curl -X POST https://control-plane.internal/api/traffic -d '{"route":"text-gen","weight":100,"version":"v2.3.0"}'
# clear canary caches
ssh infra@canary-1 'systemctl restart redis'
```
I'll have these commands ready in runbook.

Alice Tran: Suggested smoke checks (quick):
- run 3 scripted prompts through canary
- verify embedding cosine similarity > 0.92 vs baseline
- verify loopback LLM answer signature not empty
I'll attach results in ~10m.

Priya Shah: OK. Owners: Mark=deploy, Alice=smoke, Diego=rollback criteria + go/no-go, SRE-oncall=infra gating. Timeline: canary 18:00-18:10, if green promote 18:12.

Diego Morales: I reviewed telemetry dashboards. I'm +1 to go if initial 5m error <0.2% and p95 < 500ms. Otherwise hold.

Mark Liu: Noted. Will start canary at 18:00. tagging @eng-ops for standby.

Priya Shah: Preflight checklist complete. All docs linked: https://redwood/docs/releases/v2.3.1

Alice Tran: Smoke run (18:03): all 3 prompts passed, p95=320ms, errors=0.12%. Embedding sim=0.94. :thumbsup: 

Diego Morales: Based on smoke, I give go for promote at 18:12. :white_check_mark:

SRE-oncall: infra health OK. No alerts.

Mark Liu: Promoting to 100% at 18:12 now.

release-bot: Promotion complete: v2.3.1 -> 100% at 2026-03-20T18:13Z

Priya Shah: Sweet. Closing thread. If any regressions, follow rollback runbook and ping this thread.
